name: Matched Cinder
description: Throw two cinders of one heat so that they strike as a single blow.

name: Even Kindle
description: Light both palms with embers of one heat so that every following move lands evenly.

name: Cross Ember
description: Cross two ember hands before the chest to turn a blow aside.

name: Pair Sear
description: Sear the near side with one hand and the far side with the other so the burn closes round the limb.

name: Balanced Flame
description: Hold one flame above and one below the body so that a blow from either side meets heat.

name: Duo Kindling
description: Light the left hand then the right in one breath so that each strike feeds the next.

name: Evenfire Rush
description: Rush the target in two even strides with a burning palm landing at the end of each.

name: Matched Bloom
description: Plant matching blooms of flame on both sides of the target and let them swell until they meet.

name: Furnace Pair
description: Press both palms to the guard and release the stored heat through both at once to break it and burn the arm beneath.

name: Evenfire Sunder
description: The school's closing stroke: close both burning hands on the target in perfect time so two equal fires meet and burst the guard.

name: Stoop Ember
description: Drop an ember from above the head so that it falls onto the target's shoulder.

name: Hawkeye Heat
description: Raise the sight on a thread of heat and pick one body out of a crowd by its warmth.

name: Wingtip Flare
description: Flick a fire-tipped wing of qi to bat aside a strike aimed at the side.

name: Dive Scorch
description: Fall on the target from a leap and scorch the shoulder with a flaming fist.

name: Climbing Heat
description: Ride a column of rising heat up to a height that gives the high line.

name: Feather Embers
description: Shake a cloud of drifting embers from the arms that settles on everyone beneath.

name: Talon Lock
description: Close claws of fire round the target's arms and hold them down by the wrists.

name: Plunge Flame
description: Leap high and plunge onto the mark in a column of flame that burns the ground where it lands.

name: Ember Mantle
description: Spread a broad mantle of embers from the shoulders that turns blows from behind and above.

name: Brand Stoop
description: Drop onto the target and burn a seal into the chest that locks the flow of qi for a time.

name: Hawkfire Ruin
description: The school's closing stroke: fall from the high line wrapped in a hawk of fire and break the target's guard from above.

name: Kindred Spark
description: Throw a spark and let a second spark rise from the place where it lands.

name: Pyre Seedling
description: Plant a small seedling of flame at the feet to be fed into a pyre later.

name: Pyre Echo Veil
description: Hold a veil of flame and a faint second veil a pace behind it.

name: Pyre Prick
description: Drive a thin needle of fire from a pyre-seed into the target's foot.

name: Pyre Pair
description: Raise two small pyres a stride apart and scorch whoever stands between them.

name: Linked Pyres
description: Light one pyre then the next from its flame so the second erupts as the first falls.

name: Pyre Guard
description: Raise a pyre at the front of the body that burns whatever strikes it.

name: Ash Mirror
description: Set a pane of drifting ash that reflects the pyre light so that the true body is hard to find.

name: Cinder Pillars
description: Call a ring of tall cinder pillars up from the ground that close on whoever stands within.

name: Joined Pyre Crush
description: Join two pyres over the target and drop them together to crush the guard under their weight.

name: Mirrored Collapse
description: Let a pyre fall to its mirror so that both burst inward and fill the space between them with fire.

name: Kindred Conflagration
description: The school's closing stroke: raise two kindred pyres that lean on each other and collapse together on all between them.

name: Pooling Ember
description: Let heat gather in the qi field like water collecting until the pool is ready.

name: Pooled Glow
description: Read the depth of the gathered heat by the color of the glow it gives off.

name: Brimming Veil
description: Hold a veil of heat brimming at the edge so that a blow splashes harmlessly into it.

name: Overflow Burn
description: Spill part of the gathered heat outward in a low wave that burns the feet of nearby foes.

name: Gathering Heat
description: Draw the heat of nearby embers and fires into the qi field to raise the user's output.

name: Banked Flame
description: Bank a long mound of flame before the body and keep it fed through a hard exchange.

name: Spilling Pyre
description: Tip the gathered fire out over the ground in a steady spill that burns every footing it reaches.

name: Pouring Cut
description: Pour the whole gathering through one hand in a narrow cut that splits a guard.

name: Brimful Eruption
description: Let the full brim burst outward from the body in one great ring of fire.

name: Overbrim Sunder
description: The school's closing stroke: send the whole gathered fire out through one point so narrow that it pierces any guard.

name: Feeding Ember
description: Pass the heat of one ember into its pair so that both burn brighter.

name: Mutual Glow
description: Hold two glows that strengthen each other when either is struck.

name: Lasting Spark
description: Throw a spark that holds its heat and keeps burning where it lands.

name: Long Kindle
description: Raise the paired flames slowly so that their heat climbs the longer the fight goes on.

name: Twinned Coals
description: Wear two glowing coals at the chest that feed each other under a heavy blow.

name: Unflagging Burn
description: Keep a pair of flames pressed on the target without loss of heat for as long as it takes.

name: Reviving Ember
description: Rest a feeding ember on an ally's wound so that its warmth restores strength to the tired body.

name: Perpetual Sear
description: Lay a sear on the target that feeds on its own heat and does not fade.

name: Mutual Pyre
description: Raise two pyres that feed each other and widen the longer they stand.

name: Unfading Brand
description: Burn a brand into the target that keeps burning and presses the target's qi down.

name: Undying Pair
description: The school's closing stroke: feed two great fires into each other until the whole field burns without end.

name: Drifting Ember
description: Breathe on an ember so that it drifts with the wind onto the target.

name: Breath Kindle
description: Take one deep breath and light a steady flame in the chest.

name: Breath Veil
description: Breathe out a veil of warm air that thickens into flame against a blow.

name: Carried Flame
description: Carry a flame on a steady breath over a long way and set it down on the mark.

name: Sworn Sear
description: Speak the vow and sear the target with a palm that cannot be knocked from its line.

name: Draft Weave
description: Weave sparks into the draft so that the eye cannot follow where the strike will fall.

name: Gust Pyre
description: Raise a pyre in the path of the wind so that it roars and spreads along the gust.

name: Oathbound Cinders
description: Scatter cinders bound by oath so that they fall only on the foes the user has named.

name: Unspent Inferno
description: Loose a great fire that the wind will not blow out or thin before it reaches the far side.

name: Vowfire Surge
description: The school's closing stroke: speak the vow aloud and send a wind-driven wave of fire across the whole front.

name: Spoken Spark
description: Say the first word of the oath and throw a spark that holds the word.

name: Vowed Kindle
description: Swear to the flame and feel the heat in the chest steady the whole body.

name: Pledge Veil
description: Hold a veil of fire that stays lit as long as the pledge is kept.

name: Binding Ember
description: Tie an ember to the target's wrist so that the oath follows them.

name: Oath Scorch
description: Strike with a palm that carries the oath and scorches deeper the longer the oath has been held.

name: Steadfast Flame
description: Hold the flame fixed through a long storm of blows and let it take the weight.

name: Vowburn
description: Pour fire into the target through a steady grip and press them to the ground.

name: Oathfire Mending
description: Speak the oath of care and warm an ally's wound until the flesh draws together.

name: Pledged Blaze
description: Pledge the user's own heat to a single stroke that burns through the guard.

name: Fulfilled Pyre
description: Raise a pyre that burns brighter with each vow the user has kept in the fight.

name: Oathfire Cleave
description: Cleave through qi and flesh with a stroke of oath-fire that is not slowed by any guard.

name: Oath Judgment
description: The school's closing stroke: bring the whole oath down on the target in one burning stroke that cannot be turned.

name: Naked Spark
description: Throw a spark openly along a straight line with nothing to hide the throw.

name: Heat Reading
description: Hold a glow on the heading and read the heat of anything that crosses it.

name: Candid Veil
description: Spread a thin veil of fire in open view that burns whatever strikes it.

name: Straight Burn
description: Drive a burning palm straight down the line to the target without a feint.

name: Bold Flare
description: Throw a great flare in plain view that draws every eye while the real strike follows.

name: Sweeping Ember
description: Sweep a wide arm of burning embers across the front and hold it there.

name: Level Stride
description: Cross the ground in one long stride on a level jet of heat.

name: Uncovered Pyre
description: Raise a pyre in the open and let the wind carry its heat to all who offer no cover.

name: Fanned Inferno
description: Fan the flames with both arms until the inferno spreads in a wide arc.

name: Unscreened Beam
description: Hold nothing back and send a clean beam of fire along the bearing that no screen can turn.

name: Openfire Reckoning
description: The school's closing stroke: loose a great fire along the bearing that offers no cover and takes all it meets.

name: Planted Ember
description: Plant the feet and root a steady ember at the chest that takes the first blow.

name: Draft Feed
description: Let the passing draft feed the standing flame and raise its heat a step.

name: Unbent Glow
description: Hold a glow that does not bend in the wind and read the gust by the strain on it.

name: Rooted Flame
description: Stand in a rooted stance with a thick flame that does not give ground to any blow.

name: Fed Blaze
description: Strike from a fixed stance with a blaze that grows as the wind feeds it.

name: Unmoving Burn
description: Hold the target in place under a fixed burn that does not shift or ease.

name: Gale-fed Pyre
description: Stand and feed a pyre with the full strength of the wind until it towers.

name: Stand Release
description: Hold the stance for a long time and then release all the stored heat in a single strike.

name: Unbowed Inferno
description: Stand unbowed against the wind and let the full fire go outward in a ring.

name: Standing Eruption
description: The school's closing stroke: loose the whole long stand of stored fire at once from the unmoved body.

name: Wakeful Ember
description: Light an ember that does not need rest and keeps the body alert.

name: Keeping Glow
description: Keep a quiet glow round the body that holds against steady pressure.

name: Tireless Spark
description: Throw sparks one after another without any pause or loss of heat.

name: Sleepless Burn
description: Hold a flame on the target through a long exchange and never let it die.

name: Unceasing Veil
description: Renew a veil of flame as fast as blows burn it away.

name: Watchful Heat
description: Spread a patient layer of heat round the body that notices every approach.

name: Rekindling Warmth
description: Pass a patient warmth into an ally's body to restore strength through a long fight.

name: Steadfast Pyre
description: Hold a great pyre alight without fading and let its reach grow slowly.

name: Perpetual Blaze
description: Press a blaze on the target that feeds on the user's will and not on the reserve.

name: Ceaseless Inferno
description: Hold a vast fire alight on the field with no loss of heat for the length of the fight.

name: Unsetting Blaze
description: The school's closing stroke: raise a fire sworn never to set that burns on through any wind or exhaustion.
